experiment: EXP-2 of max 3 (follows the falsified EXP-1 G79-MFX)

motivation_measured_before_preregistrati.EXP1_result: G79-MFX matched filtering scored HOLDOUT-DTI 0.0504/0.0492 against a budget-matched UNIFORM control of 0.0505/0.0515 - no skill, recorded as a terminal negative.
motivation_measured_before_preregistrati.observation_that_generated_this_hypothes: Under the published metric (alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, 300 m triangular kernel) a dot that misses costs 0.2 while each uncovered truth cell costs 0.8, and TP_w uses max-over-dots per truth cell. At 0.23% truth prevalence the index is therefore dominated by COVERAGE, not precision - which is why a no-skill uniform field already scores about 0.05 and why the repository's own dense-prior lanes cluster near 0.26 on the leaderboard.

hypothesis: Because the metric is coverage-dominated, the highest-DTI emission at fixed dot cost is not the top-ranked pixels of a classifier but a kernel-spaced (3 px) space-filling lattice over a physically enriched corridor prior: the fault-likelihood region defined by magnetic structure-tensor coherence and magnetic tilt-angle contact loci, which are computed from geophysics alone and therefore contain no catalogue information.
mechanism: R = {coherence(RTP) > 0.50} union {|tilt| < 0.25} with coherence from a structure tensor of the RTP magnetic band (inner sigma 1 px, outer 3 px) and tilt recomputed as atan2(dz, |grad_h|) from the drilled RTP band; emission is a quasi-hexagonal 3 px lattice inside R restricted to allowed cells (footprint, no visible catalogue pixel, distance to visible catalogue > 0); the dot count is whatever the lattice produces, capped at 190,000, with no classifier, no ranking and no per-pixel posterior involved.
named_non_fault_process: Shallow Tertiary volcanic contacts and basalt dyke swarms produce coherent magnetic edges exactly like faults. They are NOT filtered here - this lane deliberately trades precision for coverage, so the residual mimic is a stated cost, not a claim of rejection.

prediction_written_before_measurement.enrichment_ratio: > 1.5 (withheld truth density inside R relative to outside R)
prediction_written_before_measurement.holdout_dti: > UNIFORM control at the same dot count, and > the frozen THVC incumbent 0.190517 / 0.194366 on both seeds
prediction_written_before_measurement.falsification: if enrichment <= 1.2 or the pooled DTI does not exceed both controls, the coverage hypothesis is rejected and no slot is spent

holdout_protocol.instrument: vendor/gems57/holdout.buffered_component_draw, seeds 20 and 30, 3 px feature collar, 12 px boundary erosion
holdout_protocol.evaluator: vendor/gems57/evaluate_holdout (gems57-pooled-hide-v2), pooled first then paired 20 km block bootstrap, draws=1000

decision_rule.promote: primary variant beats UNIFORM and the THVC incumbent on both seeds, and the artifact passes the official format validator
decision_rule.negative: otherwise record the terminal negative card
decision_rule.novelty_note: A coverage-optimal lattice is expected to overlap dense predecessor rasters far above the 0.70 dot-overlap rule simply because dense fields overlap dense fields. That overlap is measured and reported as a property of the strategy; it is never used to claim or deny scientific validity, and no dot is jittered to game it.
decision_rule.no_post_hoc_changes: no retuning of thresholds, lattice pitch or dot cap after seeing a score
